[A] BBC (c2lq12z1xdlo, 2026-07-16) "Andy Burnham to promise new path when he becomes new Labour leader": In Friday speech Burnham said the government will be "unashamedly Labour in our priorities" and have the "courage to fix the big things that politics has neglected"; "focused on driving growth in every postcode and returning power to communities". Cabinet announcements not expected until Monday.

[A] NYT (nytimes.com, 2026-07-17, paywalled snippet) "New Prime Minister Faces Old Problems: How to Make Britain's Economy Grow": Burnham pledge "Good growth in every British postcode"; plan is to devolve power to local officials; "the biggest change in our lifetimes to the way the country is run." Economists warn details of economic agenda not revealed.

[A] Guardian energy article confirms first speech / cost-of-living package framing (see guardian-energy-bills-heat-pumps.txt).

The Standard/RTE/Mirror [X] and Business Times/Bloomberg [X]; treat as briefed-in-advance, EXPECTED not delivered): Burnham to promise to give Britain "more breathing space"/"breathing room" on cost of living; a moment for "reflection and resolution"; be "acutely conscious" of being the sixth/seventh PM in a decade; close on "hope and unity"; "tangible" improvements.
